premises: Independent original coordinates with one-dimensional density caps at most one.
Exact rank-three factorization A=RMR^T with R^TR=I3 in the finite-ray theorem.
All physical diagonals vanish and nonzero spectral rows lie on at most five projective null rays.
Normalized one-dimensional product projection density cap sqrt(2) for each disjoint ray-bank aggregate.
Cauchy-Binet identity sum_{|J|=3} det(U_J)^2=1 for U^TU=I3.

partner_result_applied.application: Its exact three-null-ray near-coloop family has spectrum {1,1,-2}; the new bank compiler gives ||p_Q||inf <= 6*2^(1/3)=7.559526299... uniformly as D0->0.

results.statement: If Z is independent of (U,V), ||p_Z||inf<=L and ||p_(U,V)||inf<=M, then for T=2ZU+alpha U^2+beta V^2 with beta!=0, ||p_T||inf<=3*2^(2/3)(LM)^(2/3)|beta|^(-1/3).
For independent X1,X2,X3 with density caps L1,L2,L3 and invertible zero-diagonal Hessian H, arbitrary affine perturbations have density sup <=3*2^(2/3)(L1L2L3)^(2/3)|det H|^(-1/3).

For exact rank three, zero physical diagonal, min nonzero eigenvalue magnitude >=s, and at most k<=5 projective null-ray banks, ||p_Q||inf<=6*2^(2/3) C(k,3)^(1/3)/s <20.520/s. Both indefinite signatures are included.
